title: Which team should you support for the rest of the World Cup? Take our quiz to find out
content:
Editor’s note: The quiz will be updated after each remaining match in the tournament so you can play it right up until the final.

After almost a month of thrilling matches, late drama and huge talking points there are now just seven teams left in the 2026 World Cup with the quarter-finals very much underway.

If the games at the tournament so far are anything to go by then supporters of the remaining teams are in for a rollercoaster of emotions as their heroes battle it out to be crowned world champions.

Yet what if the side you support has already been eliminated? Or didn’t qualify for the competition in the first place? Who should you cheer on now? Well, don’t worry as The Athletic has compiled a quiz which will tell you exactly who you personally should be rooting for as this World Cup reaches what’s sure to be an epic conclusion.

Firstly, here are the teams left in the competition:

France
Spain
Belgium
Norway
England
Argentina
Switzerland

And here is the quiz. Enjoy and please share your result in the comments!
